deep_help.stderr:
Usage: scan-cli fs [options]

  -exclude value
    	Directory name to exclude (repeatable)
  -max-file-mb int
    	Skip files larger than this size in MB (0 = no limit)
  -no-default-excludes
    	Do not apply built-in exclude dir names (e.g. node_modules, .git)
  -no-hash
    	Disable SHA-256 hashing
  -no-projects
    	Disable project root detection
  -o string
    	Output JSON path (shorthand)
  -output string
    	Output JSON path (required)
  -root value
    	Root directory (repeatable)

preferred_help.stdout:
Filesystem scanner: paths, JSON lines, or table output (Archivist scanfs).

Usage: scanfs [OPTIONS] --root <PATH>

Options:
      --root <PATH>        Root directories to scan (at least one required)
      --exclude <GLOB>     Extra ignore-style glob (repeatable); passed to `ignore` overrides
      --hash               Compute full-file xxHash64 (hex)
      --hash-partial       Use head/tail xxHash64 instead of full file (tiered large files)
      --sha256             Compute SHA-256 (hex)
      --md5                Compute MD5 (hex) for compatibility with external dedup tools
      --profile <PROFILE>  Extraction profile controlling default depth [default: standard] [possible values: fast, standard, deep]
      --sniff-format       Sniff magic bytes / MIME
      --metadata           Read EXIF / audio tags / PDF page count / DOCX core props
      --video              Run `ffprobe` on video extensions (requires binary on PATH; 30s timeout)
      --phash              Perceptual hash (images only)
      --format <FORMAT>    Output format for normalized Item records [default: plain] [possible values: plain, json, table]
      --workers <WORKERS>  Worker threads for parallel traversal. If > 0, sets `RAYON_NUM_THREADS` [default: 0]
  -h, --help               Print help
